description: Element names and symbols practice for CHEM 1A (default) and CHEM 3A (add ?course=3A). Students pick from 4 tiles: Name → Symbol, Symbol → Name, Tricky Symbols (Na, K, Fe, Cu, Ag, Sn, Sb, Au, Hg, Pb, W and the Latin or German names they come from), and Where is it? (find elements on a clickable periodic table by group and period, by name, or by family; family names like alkali metals and halogens; metal, nonmetal or metalloid; group and period; common ions). CHEM 3A covers the first 20 elements, the health-science (body) elements and common ions; CHEM 1A adds the rest of the main group and common transition metals. Element sets: first 20, health-science set, main group, transition metals, or missed elements only, in random or atomic-number order. Symbols are graded case-sensitively, with mistake-specific feedback for capitalization (Co vs CO), Latin-symbol, look-alike and family mix-ups; names accept aluminium, sulphur and caesium. Skill Check Prep: 10 mixed questions, then a study plan. Hints, step-by-step help, Professor Tips, a rules sheet, a hide-the-names study reference, a missed-elements review list, XP, ranks, 10 achievements, and ItsDrDan videos that jump to the right moment.
